name: RAG Memory
description: Local-first memory system for OpenClaw. Bridges the simple-rag-arch SQLite database for persistent session summaries, knowledge notes, workflow checkpoints, and cross-session recall.

agentId.description: Agent ID in the RAG database

autoSaveSessions.description: Auto-save session summaries to RAG on conversation end

injectContext.description: Inject RAG context into system prompt before each turn

agentId.label: RAG Agent ID
agentId.help: The agent identity used when saving sessions and notes to the RAG database.

autoSaveSessions.label: Auto-Save Sessions
autoSaveSessions.help: When enabled, each conversation turn is automatically saved to the RAG session store.

injectContext.label: Inject RAG Context
injectContext.help: When enabled, relevant RAG notes and recent sessions are injected into the system prompt for context awareness.
